messages:

Subject: Vendor setup questions — PO fields & line-item format for Atlas Cloud activation

Hi Markus / team,

Thanks again — we're excited to get Redwood activated in our procurement system ahead of the integration scheduled for the week of June 14. To avoid delays on our side I wanted to confirm a couple of items so our AP and Sourcing teams can raise the initial PO without rework: 

1) What exact fields must appear on the PO for Redwood to process invoices (legal name, supplier number, tax ID, etc.)?
2) Do you have a preferred line-item structure / CSV template we should use so item codes map into our ERP?
3) What is your typical lead time from supplier form submission to PO issuance? We can prioritize on our end if we know the gating items.

We also need your supplier onboarding form (for KYC / tax) and a copy of payment terms to attach to our internal file. If you can point us to a single downloadable pack or attach the docs here that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Julien
Procurement Manager, Atlas Cloud

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor setup questions — PO fields & line-item format for Atlas Cloud activation

Julien — thanks for the clear list. Below is what our procurement & finance teams require to accept a PO and process invoices without delay. I’ve attached our supplier form and a line-item CSV template.

Required PO fields (must appear on the PO document):
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Redwood supplier number: will be provided once onboarding form is returned (if you already have a supplier id, include it).
- Redwood Tax ID / VAT: EIN 12-3456789 (US) / VAT ID upon supplier setup (we'll include in the onboarding reply).
- Billing contact email: ap@redwoodinference.com
- Currency: USD (unless you request EUR and we agree in writing)
- PO number (your PO id) — please include in the invoice subject and the first line of the invoice body.

Preferred line-item structure (fields we map to our ERP):
- item_code (string, max 40 chars)
- description (free text; include environment/tag if relevant e.g., "prod cluster - inference hours")
- sku (internal SKU if you provide one)
- unit_of_measure (e.g., hour, seat, license, one-time)
- quantity
- unit_price (currency-per-unit)
- start_date / end_date (ISO dates for subscription or monthly billing)
- cost_center_id (optional; if provided we will map it)
- external_reference (optional; your internal cost code)

Notes on grouping and subtotal lines: we prefer split usage-based line items (e.g., compute_hours) rather than a single "misc services" line so cost allocation remains accurate. If you need consolidated billing, flag that in the PO and we'll accept a monthly consolidated invoice that references all PO numbers.

Timeline & gating items:
- Supplier onboarding form returned + signed W-9 / tax docs: target T+0 to T+5 business days to set up supplier record.
- Once supplier record is live, PO issuance typically takes 48–72 business hours from receipt of a completed SOW/quote and internal approvals.
- If Atlas can provide the completed onboarding form and SOW together we can usually commit to a PO by June 3 (assuming forms arrive by EOD June 1).

Attachments included: redwood_supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (please complete and return), po_lineitem_template.csv (sample format), redwood_payment_terms.pdf (Net30 standard; exceptions handled case-by-case).

I’ll also add a small checklist below (for AP):
- Return completed onboarding form (PDF) + signed SOW / order summary
- Confirm currency and billing cadence (monthly recommended)
- Provide AP contact for invoices and remittance address (if different from billing contact)

If you want me to include our legal/procurement lead on a short call to clear any contract/PO questions, tell me times that work and we'll set it up.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-05-31T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup questions — PO fields & line-item format for Atlas Cloud activation

Quick clarification from finance/ops perspective:

- Invoicing cadence: we default to monthly consolidated invoices per PO unless you request split (usage-based) invoices. If Atlas wants weekly usage invoices we can support but you should note that in the PO and we may apply a minimal processing surcharge.

- Consolidated monthly invoice: we can accept a single monthly invoice that references multiple PO numbers — but each line on the invoice must include the originating PO number for reconciliation.

- Custom metadata fields (cost_center_id): yes, we can map a cost_center_id up to 20 characters from the CSV into our ERP. If your cost center values are numeric-only, please send a sample list and we'll confirm mapping rules.

- Partial invoices / pro-rated subscription lines: supported — include start_date / end_date columns on the invoice lines.

I’ll follow up if the AP system needs any further constraints (maximum line count per invoice, file naming conventions).

Thanks,
Dev
Procurement Systems Engineer

Laura Bennett
